metadata.dcterms:title: Gröbner-Shirshov bases and PBW theorems
metadata.dcterms:creator: School of Mathematical Sciences, South China Normal University
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We review some applications of Gr¨obner-Shirshov bases, including PBW the- orems, linear bases of free universal algebras, normal forms for groups and semigroups, extensions of groups and algebras, embedding of algebras.
